class: Authentication dispatch blocked by final-submission containment
symptom: The cloud browser remained on a filled Sign In form with no visible rejection, while the login attempt ledger recorded a rejection and paused the run.
root_cause: A structural submit button is blocked by default, including Sign In. The login helper tried multiple guarded clicks and then Enter, and treated the unchanged password form as a failed sign-in even though containment prevented dispatch.
why_tests_missed: Existing authentication fixtures used non-form buttons without the production submission guard. Account-creation gateway tests did not cover sign-in.
fix: Add a single-use dedicated sign-in credential capability, revalidate its form at click and submit time, and stop failed dispatch without retrying Enter or recording rejection. Preserve genuine rejected-login accounting and final submission containment.
prevention: Exercise authentication helpers with real structural forms and the production guard armed, checking both network-equivalent form dispatch and durable attempt accounting.
